annotations.title: Pictures of the real pages, as the book prints.

description: Returns pictures of the spreads the book prints, laid out by the same code that makes the printer’s file: a page by its number, a person’s first page, or the first message when neither is given. Show each as an image so the person sees their book before they change or order it.

pages.description: Page numbers, up to four. Each picture is the spread the page is on.

person.description: A name as it prints, for that person’s first page.
